name: 📊 BP AI — Department KPI Scorecard
description: Daily 21:00 Riyadh: scores 11 AI departments from Tasks + Deals: closure, open/waiting work, human escalations, pipeline, revenue and paid-blocked execution. No AI tokens.

parameters.jsCode: const all=$input.all().map(i=>i.json||{}); const managers={sales:'badr_sales',marketing:'farah_marketing',legal:'abdulaziz_legal',finance:'abdulrahman_finance',operations:'mazen_ops',compliance_gro:'mishari_compliance',hr:'nasser_hr',procurement:'abdullah_procurement',it:'mohammed_it',digital_product:'website_funnel_ops',strategy_pmo:'ahmed_strategy'}; const agentDept=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(managers).map(([d,a])=>[a,d])); const dep={}; for(const [d,m] of Object.entries(managers))dep[d]={department:d,manager_agent:m,tasks_completed:0,tasks_open:0,tasks_waiting:0,human_escalations:0,active_deals:0,pipeline_value:0,collected_revenue:0,paid_blocked_count:0}; const riyadhDate=(v)=>{const t=Date.parse(v||''); if(!Number.isFinite(t))return ''; return new Date(t+3*3600000).toISOString().slice(0,10);}; const today=new Date(Date.now()+3*3600000).toISOString().slice(0,10); const tasks=all.filter(x=>x.task_id); const deals=all.filter(x=>x.deal_id); for(const t of tasks){let d=agentDept[t.assigned_to_agent]||agentDept[t.created_by_agent]; if(!d||!dep[d])continue; const s=String(t.status||'').toLowerCase(); if(s==='completed'&&riyadhDate(t.updated_at)===today)dep[d].tasks_completed++; if(['queued','in_progress'].includes(s))dep[d].tasks_open++; if(s==='waiting')dep[d].tasks_waiting++; if(t.human_action_required===true)dep[d].human_escalations++; } for(const x of deals){const stage=String(x.stage||'').toLowerCase(); const exec=String(x.execution_status||'').toLowerCase(); const active=!['delivered','lost','cancelled','canceled'].includes(stage); const ownerDept=agentDept[x.deal_owner]; if(active&&ownerDept&&dep[ownerDept])dep[ownerDept].active_deals++; if(active){dep.sales.pipeline_value+=Number(x.deal_value||x.quoted_amount||0);} const paid=Number(x.paid_amount||0); dep.sales.collected_revenue+=paid; dep.finance.collected_revenue+=paid; if(paid>0&&!['completed','delivered'].includes(exec)&&stage!=='delivered')dep.operations.paid_blocked_count++; } const now=new Date().toISOString(); return Object.values(dep).map(r=>{let score=100-(r.paid_blocked_count*15)-(r.human_escalations*5)-(r.tasks_waiting*2)-Math.min(r.tasks_open,20)+Math.min(r.tasks_completed*2,20); score=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Math.round(score))); const activity=r.tasks_completed+r.tasks_open+r.tasks_waiting+r.active_deals; return {json:{snapshot_id:`${today}-${r.department}`,snapshot_date:`${today}T21:00:00+03:00`,...r,score,notes:activity===0?'No recorded workload/activity in this snapshot.':'Score rewards closure and penalizes open/waiting/human escalation; Operations is additionally penalized for paid-but-not-completed deals.',created_at:now}};});
